title: oxytropis sericea subsp. spicata
intro: Oxytropis sericea subsp. spicata, commonly known as silky globeflower or silky locoweed, is a plant species in the Fabaceae family. It is reported to have various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of certain diseases. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to stimulate cardiovascular function, reduce blood pressure, and exhibit antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of Oxytropis sericea subsp. spicata include isoflavonoids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
